key_findings: Cilostazol reversed ischemia-induced allodynia/hyperalgesia and ACC neuronal damage in rats, with reduced TRPA1, glutamate and NLRP3/caspase-1/IL-1beta.
Cilostazol restored the Akt/TrkB/CREB/BDNF and SIRT-1/FOXO3a/Nrf2 axes.
